title: Lentil Curry
description: A flavorful and nutritious curry made with lentils, inspired by British cuisine. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy vegetarian meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lentils and stir to coat with curry powder.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
